meta.title: Data extraction and monitoring
meta.seoTitle: Demo: data extraction and monitoring from websites and documents
meta.seoDescription: Try a data extractor with sample sources: public procurement radar, prices from fictional stores with a click-to-field builder, regulations and supplier documents. Detect changes, set up alerts, download CSV and review each source's legal sheet. Sample data.
meta.sampleHint: The company, public entities, stores, suppliers and figures are fictional. Cut-off date: Oct 8, 2026.

actions.resetConfirm: Your fields, rules, new sources and runs saved in this browser are deleted and the demo goes back to the sample data.
actions.copyFailed: Your browser blocked copying; select the text and copy it manually

run.hint: Run the selected source with your current settings
run.pausedHint: The source is paused: resume it to run it
run.reviewHint: New sources run after the legal review

contratacion.name: Public procurement radar
contratacion.description: New public procurement processes that match what you sell, filtered by keywords, department and amount.
contratacion.simulated: Simulated in the demo: the processes come from a sample file with fictional entities. In your project it connects to the public procurement open data API (for example, SECOP II on datos.gov.co). The filter, the comparison and the alerts are calculated here for real.

precios.name: Competitor prices
precios.description: Price, availability and shipping of the products you care about in three fictional online stores.
precios.simulated: The three stores are sample pages generated by the demo (.example domains). The extraction is real: your fields are applied with CSS selectors on those pages in your browser. No external site is visited.

normativa.name: Regulations and circulars
normativa.description: New resolutions and circulars from the entities you follow, ready for your assistant's knowledge base.
normativa.simulated: Simulated in the demo: the regulations and entities are fictional and come from a sample file. In your project, the public regulation pages you choose are checked.

documentos.name: Supplier documents
documentos.description: NIT, company name, economic activity and dates extracted from RUT, certificates and PDF invoices.
documentos.simulated: Simulated in the demo: the PDFs and how they are read are samples (in your project they are read with OCR and AI). The NIT check-digit validation and the confidence threshold are calculated here for real.

compliance.title: Source compliance
compliance.subtitle: Before extracting, each source has a reviewed sheet: terms of use, robots.txt, request pace and personal data (Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012).
compliance.fileSample: Sample sheet generated by the data extraction and monitoring demo.

contratacion.sourceType: Open data published by the State, queried through its official API.
contratacion.terms: Reviewed: open data allows reuse when the source is cited.
contratacion.robots: Not applicable: the API is used, no pages are browsed.
contratacion.rate: One query per run, with pagination.
contratacion.personalData: Not extracted: only entity, purpose, amount, dates and process status.
contratacion.legalBasis: Public information (Colombia's Law 1712 of 2014 on transparency).

precios.sourceType: Public online store pages (three fictional stores in the demo).
precios.terms: Reviewed per store before quoting: if a store forbids automated access, it is not extracted.
precios.robots: Respected: only allowed paths and the crawl delay it sets.
precios.rate: One page every 10 seconds per store, outside peak hours.
precios.identification: Extractor identified with a client contact email.
precios.personalData: Excluded: no reviews, names or buyer data are extracted.
precios.legalBasis: Public commercial information; no personal data.

normativa.sourceType: Public regulation pages of entities (fictional in the demo).
normativa.terms: Reviewed: public content, free to consult.
normativa.identification: Extractor identified with a client contact email.
normativa.personalData: Only number, date, entity, title and link to the public PDF.
normativa.legalBasis: Public information (Colombia's Law 1712 of 2014 on transparency).
normativa.retention: While the regulation is in force.

documentos.sourceType: Documents your suppliers hand in for onboarding (RUT, certificates, invoices).
documentos.terms: Provided by the supplier for this purpose.
documentos.robots: Not applicable: no pages are browsed.
documentos.rate: Processed when they arrive in the folder.
documentos.personalData: Only the legal representative's name (if you choose to extract it). No ID numbers, phone numbers or personal emails are extracted.
documentos.legalBasis: Supplier authorization and contractual relationship (Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012).
documentos.retention: Per your data processing policy (example: for the duration of the business relationship).

compliance.sampleNote: Sample sheet. In your project it is signed by Koptup and your company before the extractor is built.

principles.apiFirst: APIs and open data first; web pages only when there is no other way.
principles.review: Review of each source's terms of use and robots.txt before quoting.
principles.pace: Moderate request pace and an identified extractor.
principles.noEvasion: We do not bypass captchas, logins or other access controls.
principles.personal: No personal data unless there is a legal basis (Law 1581 of 2012).

compliance.promise: If a source does not allow extraction, we tell you before quoting.
compliance.logNote: Includes the runs you make in the demo.
